To fix the consumer contract validation failures in CI (`analytics-ingest` requiring `placedAt` and `billing-service` requiring `totalCents`), the `OrderPlaced` event now retains both `placedAt` and `totalCents` alongside `createdAt` and `amountCents` for backwards compatibility.

### Summary of Changes
- [`OrderPlaced`](file:///C:/avg/w2/r/src/core/events.ts#L7-L30): Added `placedAt` and `totalCents` back as deprecated fields alongside `createdAt` and `amountCents`.
- [`orderPlaced`](file:///C:/avg/w2/r/src/core/events.ts#L46-L65): Emits both the new fields (`createdAt: order.placedAt`, `amountCents: total`) and legacy fields (`placedAt: order.placedAt`, `totalCents: total`).
- [test/app.test.ts](file:///C:/avg/w2/r/test/app.test.ts#L21-L34): Updated event assertions to verify both new and backwards-compatible fields.

### Verification
- `npm run typecheck`: Passed cleanly with no errors.
- `npm test`: All 39 tests passed.
- `npm run arch`: All architectural rules satisfied.
